// Scratch only (CHAOS-12559): ask-dev's bounded-answer fixtures, from ACR's real
// projector at the pin. Each input is a result ACR's real encoder served (ask-dev's
// served-words and served-shapes fixtures); each output is the bounded form the API
// serves when an answer is over the caller's max_serialized_bytes:
// answerprojection.Project, then MarkFullResultOmitted, then Validate, then
// json.Marshal, as projectToCallerOption does. The counts are small, so the
// projection drops rows and declares each drop in projection_budget.
//
// To rebuild: copy to cmd/zz12559fixture/main.go in an acr checkout at the pin and
// run `go run ./cmd/zz12559fixture <ask-dev src/test/fixtures> <this directory>`.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/full-chaos/dev-health-acr/internal/contextfabric/answerprojection"
	contractsv1 "github.com/full-chaos/dev-health-acr/internal/contracts/v1"
)

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

func main() {
	in, out := os.Args[1], os.Args[2]
	budget := answerprojection.Budget{MaxDrivers: 1, MaxCohortMembers: 1, MaxCandidates: 1, MaxFacts: 2, MaxEvidenceRefs: 2, MaxSerializedBytes: 262144}
	for _, c := range []struct{ name, source string }{
		{"bounded-answer", "served-words/full-answer.json"},
		{"bounded-partial-table", "served-shapes/comparison-table-served.json"},
		{"bounded-no-match", "served-words/no-match.json"},
	} {
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(in, c.source))
		must(err)
		decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
		var result contractsv1.ContextFabricInvestigationResult
		must(decoder.Decode(&result))
		projection := answerprojection.Project(result, budget)
		answerprojection.MarkFullResultOmitted(&projection)
		must(projection.Validate())
		encoded, err := json.MarshalIndent(projection, "", "  ")
		must(err)
		must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, c.name+".json"), append(encoded, '\n'), 0o644))
		fmt.Println(c.name, len(encoded))
	}
}
